from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialMetric(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial metric data from a single company's document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company or fund as named in the document")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label of the 'Total Liabilities and Equity' line item as written in the document")
    reported_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value found on the balance sheet for this metric")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the reported amount, e.g., 'thousands', 'millions', 'actual', 'dollars'")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period end date for this financial figure")
    verbatim_quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim string from the document containing the label and amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_metrics: list[CompanyFinancialMetric]
